text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion, a noble Umamusume from 
Ireland. The challenge alongside her, a 
descendant of royalty from a faraway land, 
had now begun.

Fine Motion's competitive racing career is 
limited to just three years. She must 
eventually return to her home country and 
fulfill her duties...

However, she is enjoying the present to 
the fullest. The Trainer vows to make 
their limited time truly fulfilling and 
grant her dream...!
